usage: Used as a noun to refer to a bus, a common form of public transport
Commonly used when talking about commuting, travel, bus stops, routes, or fares
Often appears with verbs such as take, wait for, miss, or get on and off
Can be used in everyday situations involving city travel or going to school or work
